description: This file defines the ColumnarBatch class, which wraps multiple ColumnVectors to represent a row-wise table for Spark's columnar data processing. It provides methods for resource management, iteration over rows, and access to columns and individual rows.

classes.name: ColumnarBatch
classes.description: A class that manages a batch of column vectors, providing row-wise access and resource management for Spark SQL's vectorized processing.

methods.name: close
methods.description: Closes all column vectors in the batch, releasing resources.

methods.name: closeIfFreeable
methods.description: Closes column vectors if their resources are freeable, used for memory cleanup.

methods.name: rowIterator
methods.description: Returns an iterator over the rows in the batch.

methods.name: setNumRows
methods.description: Sets the number of rows in the batch.

methods.name: numCols
methods.description: Returns the number of columns in the batch.

methods.name: numRows
methods.description: Returns the number of rows in the batch.

methods.name: column
methods.description: Returns the column vector at the specified ordinal.

methods.name: getRow
methods.description: Returns the row at the specified rowId, reusing the same InternalRow object.
